source_snapshot.procedure: Run nvsm dump health to generate a health report file.
source_snapshot.criteria: Health report file can be generated and readable.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; package/report existence but incomplete artifact controls.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED/HIGH; path/permission/retention/integrity, authoritative health specification and log preservation required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Captures basic generation but not secure artifact handling or content completeness.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Separates file-generation acceptance from any health verdict and adds content comparison.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Live `show health` checks state; this case verifies generation of a retained diagnostic artifact.

original_test_intent: Generate a complete, readable NVSM health-report artifact for the correct host, retain it securely and make its component health content available for governed comparison without claiming the system healthy from file existence alone.
original_method: Pin approved NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; choose an approved unique output directory with space/permission/retention controls; run exact `nvsm dump health`; capture reported path, exit and timestamps; verify regular-file identity, nonzero size, ownership, permissions, checksum and parse/readability; inspect required sections against expected inventory/health manifest; avoid exposing secrets.
manual_activity: Platform/security owner approves report location, retention/redaction and health-content manifest; generation and validation are automated.
required_inputs: Output location, free-space, permissions and retention policy
Expected report schema/sections and managed-device health manifest
safety_requirements: Avoid overwrite via unique path and reject symlinks/untrusted locations
Restrict permissions and redact secrets before sharing
Do not treat file existence as healthy DUT
agent_execution_scope: Report content comparison without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command is applicable but file existence alone omits safe path, integrity, permissions, retention and content scope.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command once in an approved unique directory, hash the artifact and validate required sections.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Health-report generation and readability remain the source acceptance; health status is reported separately.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a manifest containing path, size, hash, permissions, tool/host/time and required-section validation, with controlled retention.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes report generation secure and traceable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not inflate file readability into a DUT health verdict.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reports can contain identifiers, logs or secrets and may be large; schema changes with NVSM version.

project_override_considerations: Project policy defines retention, redaction and whether content-health comparison is required in addition to generation/readability.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require generation of a readable health report; content health is additional governed evidence, not a replacement acceptance claim.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package, artifact location and handling policy are provisionable.

review_improvement: Secures and fingerprints the diagnostic artifact while preventing readability from being mislabeled as hardware health.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful command may return a stale, empty, partial or misdirected file. File identity, nonzero size, checksum, permissions and required sections establish that the intended host produced a usable artifact; content findings still require separate disposition.
